verdict.rationale: Org-wide admin policy enforcement is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of admin-enforced policies such as required app lock, export restrictions, or master-credential strength rules. The closest items are user-level export options and per-vault sharing permissions, which are adjacent features, not org-wide policy enforcement.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
